comment: The engines every scan runs. Opengrep: a release binary, checked against the sha256 here (scripts/bump_engine.py moves it). Trivy: built from source at `trivy.version` on MicroHealth's FIPS Go image with the Go Cryptographic Module (GOFIPS140), every module checked against sum.golang.org. ZAP: pinned in .github/workflows/zap.yml with the sha256 of every file it fetches.
name: opengrep

trivy.note: 0.75.0 needs Go 1.27; fips-go ships the go1.26 line
